name: Breizh Cola
verdict: Breton cola brewed since 2002 by the Brasserie Lancelot (La Mine d'Or, Val d'Oust), part of the farmer-owned cooperative Agrial since its 2021 buy-up of the Phare Ouest group. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: chain ends in the farmer members of the Agrial cooperative (nature juridique 6317) — private farmer ownership, not state. No state or fund stake found → none. Breizh Cola is a club partner (business.sb29.bzh/partenaire/breizh-cola/) but does not appear on the 2026-27 home shirt; it is kept rated for the partnership.
